text: C5d opens (the Gioia table, the dynamic model, the figure, the handback and the interview). Read AGENT.md, the head, the stage file, diary --last 5, validate.py --open C5 (0 errors, 0 warnings). The passes stopped at pass 10; nothing below the model moves now. This leg writes data_structure-C5.md (section 9, with the rule that chose its rows in notes-C5.md), figure-C5.md as text and drawing (section 10), implications-C5.md with transferability (sections 11 and 12) and the comparison of rooms whose record says their work was kept (section 13), handback-C5.md, interview/C5d.md, the head, and closes with done.sh C5 --cut interview.

The rule that chooses data_structure-C5.md's rows (section 9), written before the table is built. One row per third-order theme that a fourth-order theme gathers (195 rows), ordered by dimension, fourth-order theme and member; then the two third-order themes no fourth-order theme picked up (T3-017, T3-133) below the table with their account from fourth.md's foot and one quote. Each row's quote is one concept cited under its third-order theme (support_by_theme in assignments_final.jsonl). To show the range, not the centre: within each fourth-order theme the k-th member takes a room from the k-th quartile of rooms by items_in_window (k taken mod 4, quartiles over the 705 rooms), and within that quartile the candidates are shuffled with random.Random(20261015); the first candidate of 5 to 40 words with no table-breaking character (no |, no double quote, no line break), from a room not yet used in that fourth-order theme, is taken; if the quartile has none, the next quartile in order. If no candidate in any quartile passes, the row carries the coder's second-order theme label and says so. The chosen quote enters through cite.py, with its community, author, hour and concept id.

data_structure-C5.md written (c5d_data_structure.py, by the rule logged before it): 195 rows, one per third-order theme a fourth-order theme gathers, ordered by dimension, fourth-order theme and member; quotes by room-size quartile in turn within each fourth-order theme (45, 55, 56 and 36 rows from the four quartiles), each through cite.py with community, author, hour and concept id; one theme (T3-144, recruiting quietly) has no cited concept and its row says so; the residue below the table: T3-017 (ordinary sub talk) and T3-133 (a hacked sub), each with its account and a quote; no fourth-order theme lacks a dimension. validate.py: all 192 quotes resolve; every third-order theme, fourth-order theme and dimension appears.

figure-C5.md written final (c5d_figure.py): all 23 standing elements, 21 boxes in three columns (K01 a box with no arrow; C01 and C02 beside), the hour 73 terminus, 20 arrows each with its proposition, strength, grounding, count and instance (19 shown by an audited transition, 1 by a quote: A10), two drawings as text and as Mermaid (with the theorised A11 and A12, and without), no loop (loops.jsonl empty), and what it leaves out: the field's tentative arrow, the tentative and candidate elements, seven fourth-order themes no element uses (Sensemaking, Backstage decision-making, Territoriality, Attribution, Neo-tribes, Symbolic boundaries, Visibility returns), the residue T3-017 and T3-133, and the register the topic-based coder tier scattered (CC-057, the room's own world used to do the canvas work). implications-C5.md written: the theory question in the model's terms; two counterfactuals at a leaf (day9 borrowing ubc's A05 and A14; ultrahardcore borrowing the spine's A03 and A04); transferability with the six conditions, the frame (705 coded of a 706 target census excluding r/place, r/the_donald not coded, A1 dropped none) and where the model should hold and break; ten expectations for the return; and which forms keep the work alive from the record (kept 347, lost 218, silent 140 of 705; in the middle half by size the kept share rises a little with upkeep, border talk, attack calls, the move and contest talk, falls with doubt; the clearest difference is less silence; organizing_end_hour median 72.02; aftermath share mean 0.020; about members' words, not the canvas).

handback-C5.md written: the claim, the room that best supports it (day9) and the one that most threatens it (thebluecorner), the condition between them; the ten passes and what each changed; arrangements, cuts, tier events by tier (fourth 55 amendments and 2 membership changes, dimensions 15, third 2 themes re-homed, no second-order theme moved); the readers' fidelity both ways and their rooms; propositions (9; thin 3; wholly theorised 1; from-literature 2); the figure (21 boxes, 20 arrows, 19 by transition, 1 by quote, the field's tentative arrow not drawn); the data structure (195 rows, the rule); ten expectations; what the account showed that the room notes did not; the sentence I am least sure of (Stigmergy's name over one member); the four licences; confidence and what the strict reading cost. interview/C5d.md written (what I did, found, what surprised me, what I doubt, three questions).

The ten expectations for the return, written in implications-C5.md (for stage D1's EXPECTATIONS.jsonl): (1) the spine, R01 or P01 before P03 and P03 before P05, absent where a member placed alone or found the mark placed; (2) P08 after P05 among neighbours, border talk first in late rooms asking for space; (3) P07 after P09 with refusals giving a reason, and C02 in some rooms with an old rivalry; (4) K02 before P10 only after a loss, absent in moves by choice or a coalition's plan; (5) C01 mostly absent, more often present in rooms governing a territory for a colour or vetting guests; (6) P20 after P01 in standing subs, weaker in subs opened for the canvas; (7) P14 after P05 under strain, scripts first where a room scripted from the start; (8) P11, P12, P13 in order, no placement after hour 73, curation near and after the close; (9) K01 beside the work with no delay; (10) colour factions and rooms whose host rules on guests composing with a residue.

C5d closing: the head rewritten for the close of C5 (2,980 words; links resolve; the next comparison points to the next stage file and the expectations in implications-C5.md). validate.py C5: 0 errors, 0 warnings; no .pause. Outputs: data_structure-C5.md (195 rows, 192 quotes), figure-C5.md (21 boxes, 20 arrows), implications-C5.md (ten expectations), handback-C5.md, interview/C5d.md (705 words). The model and its tiers are fixed at this close. Slip: the head named a stage id the link check does not resolve; reworded before the close.
